subject: Quick recap + checking if priorities shifted for Tessel.ai
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Allegra Thompson <allegra@tessel.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap — quick notes and next steps

Hi Allegra — thanks again for carving out 30 minutes today. Quick recap from my side and a suggested next step so we can keep momentum: 

What we heard
- Primary goal: reduce latency on embeddings-based search across multimodal product catalog (target <100ms median).
- Data controls: need VPC + customer-managed KMS for product signals and PII handling.
- Compliance: SOC 2 in play; procurement will need a summary of logs/audit capabilities.
- Timeline: evaluating pilots in July; decision window late Q3.

What Redwood can do (short list)
- Hosted API for rapid POC or Redwood Private for isolated networking and KMS.
- Dedicated pools to hit consistent latency targets; previewed quantization options for cost.
- Observability: token-level cost and per-route latency dashboards we can share.

Suggested next step
- I attached a short discovery notes PDF and a draft mutual action plan (MAP). If it helps, we can book a 20-minute technical alignment with one of our solutions engineers next week to scope a pilot and confirm perf targets.

Attachments: 20260614_Tessel_discovery_notes.pdf; mutual_action_plan_v1.xlsx

Thanks — happy to adjust if I missed anything.

Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0149

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Allegra Thompson <allegra@tessel.ai>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap — quick notes and next steps

Allegra — Ben here (copied Camila). Wanted to follow up on Camila's recap and see if you had a chance to review the MAP and discovery notes. Two quick items: 

1) Is the timeline still July for pilots? If that's shifted, understanding the new horizon helps us prioritize SE availability.
2) If helpful, we can introduce you to Jae (solutions eng) for a short perf/architecture run-through — 30 min to map concrete success criteria.

No pressure — just checking in. If you prefer, tell us what's easiest (a quick call, suggested scope edits to the MAP, or a note that you're pausing).

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com

Date: Sun, 21 Jun 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Checking in — have priorities changed? (quick options)

Allegra — quick bump on this thread. Hoping to get a sense of where things stand on your side. A few options to make this low-effort on your calendar: 

- Option A: 10-minute catch-up this week to confirm pilot scope and perf target (I can send short agenda).
- Option B: We share a pared-down pilot proposal (3 bullet success criteria + required artifacts) for your procurement/engineering review.
- Option C: If this isn't a fit right now, a one-line reply helps us close the loop on our side.

If I don't hear back, I'll assume you prefer us to pause outreach and will follow up in mid-July.
